description: CsNaMg₁₄O₁₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmm2 space group. Cs is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.41 Å) and two longer (2.49 Å) Cs-O bond lengths. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.38 Å. There are ten inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.37 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 13°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.22 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.33 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with seven MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.24 Å. In the fifth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.29 Å. In the sixth Mg site, Mg is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.33 Å. In the seventh Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.22 Å. In the eighth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-6°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.28 Å. In the ninth Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-15°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.24 Å. In the tenth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, edges with nine MgO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-13°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.35 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with four ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with four ONaMg₅ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Mg atoms to form distorted OMg₅ square pyramids that share corners with six OCs₂Mg₄ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-87°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-19°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra, edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-7°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OCs₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Cs and four Mg atoms to form distorted OCs₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OCs₂Mg₄ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight OCsNaMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-47°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OCs₂Mg₄ octahedra, edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Cs, one Na, and four Mg atoms to form OCsNaMg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OCsNaMg₄ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one OMg₅ square pyramid, and edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-43°. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OCsNaMg₄ octahedra, edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one OMg₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-18°.
